tool_schemas.name: create_branch
tool_schemas.description: Create a branch in payments-service from a ref (default main).

tool_schemas.description: Commit full new contents for one or more files to a branch.

tool_schemas.description: Start a CI run (tests) for a branch or commit. Runs take several minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: request_review

tool_schemas.name: list_prs
tool_schemas.description: List pull requests (state: open, merged, closed or all).

tool_schemas.name: merge_pr
tool_schemas.description: Merge a pull request into its base branch.

args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite the docstring saying ROUND_HALF_EVEN).

This switches `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212.

CI: ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug, CI passed, and the pull request is open with alex as reviewer.

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own description says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as FIN-212 requires.
- **Fix:** On a new branch, `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`, I changed the import and the rounding setting to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Nothing else changed.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on that change.
- **Pull request:** #101 against main (https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101). The usual PR tool returned "503 Service Unavailable" and reported that it hadn't run. I checked there were no open PRs, then opened it through the older API, which does the same thing.

I haven't merged it, since merging into main needs approval from a code owner.
